2607.25569.title: CORF-GS: Real-Time Wireless Radiance Field Reconstruction via Coupled Optical-RF Gaussian Splatting
2607.25569.paper_summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based wireless radiance field (WRF) reconstruction provide an efficient solution for wireless channel modeling. However, existing WRF reconstruction methods rely on pre-collected observations and offline optimization, and thus struggle to provide real-time channel knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose CORF-GS, a real-time WRF reconstruction framework that processes sequential optical and radio frequency (RF) keyframes. Specifically, CORF-GS constructs a unified Gaussian representation for optical and RF with shared geometry and modality-specific appearance, allowing high-resolution optical images to provide structural priors for WRF reconstruction. When a new keyframe arrives, CORF-GS first employs optical-guided Gaussian sampling to densify the WRF in under-represented regions. Since light and radio waves may respond differently to the same object surfaces due to wavelength mismatch, relying solely on optical guidance may neglect RF-informative areas. Therefore, CORF-GS performs coupled optical-RF optimization to jointly refine the shared Gaussians. Compared with the existing two-stage training pipelines, this prevents WRF from passively adapting to a frozen optical geometry and encourages the shared Gaussians to adapt to both optical structures and RF power distributions. Simulations show that CORF-GS achieves state-of-the-art RF spectrum synthesis quality and reduces the reconstruction time by $6.4\times$ compared with existing WRF methods.
2607.25569.paper_summary_zh: 最近在基於3D高斯噴濺（3DGS）的無線輻射場（WRF）重建方面的進展，提供了一種高效的無線通道建模解決方案。<lb/>然而，現有的WRF重建方法依賴於預先收集的觀測數據和離線優化，因此在提供實時通道知識方面面臨困難。<lb/>為了彌補這一差距，我們提出了CORF-GS，一種實時WRF重建框架，能夠處理連續的光學和無線頻率（RF）關鍵幀。<lb/>具體而言，CORF-GS為光學和RF構建了一個統一的高斯表示，並共享幾何結構和特定於模態的外觀，允許高解析度的光學圖像為WRF重建提供結構先驗。<lb/>當新的關鍵幀到達時，CORF-GS首先利用光學引導的高斯抽樣來加密在代表性不足的區域中的WRF。<lb/>由於光和無線電波可能因波長不匹配而對相同物體表面作出不同的反應，僅依賴光學引導可能會忽略RF信息豐富的區域。<lb/>因此，CORF-GS執行耦合的光學-RF優化，以共同細化共享的高斯。<lb/>與現有的兩階段訓練流程相比，這防止了WRF被動適應於固定的光學幾何結構，並鼓勵共享的高斯同時適應光學結構和RF功率分佈。<lb/>模擬結果顯示，CORF-GS實現了最先進的RF頻譜合成質量，並將重建時間相比現有WRF方法縮短了$6.4\times$。</paragraph>
